results.description:
Welcome to the Witch Shifter Clan!
Three sisters. Three powerful hybrids. One unforgettable bond.
A spellbinding paranormal romance collection full of fated mates, magical secrets, and swoony Shifter heroes.

They were born rare—hybrids of Witch and Shifter blood, bound by destiny and the magic in their veins. But fate doesn't make things easy.

FIRE WOLF
Martina Harbor returns home expecting birthday cake—not a mate-hungry Wolf who insists she belongs to him. After a lifetime of hiding who she is, can she risk trusting the Pack again… or her own heart?

SNOW FOX
Nova Harbor is a brilliant scientist with a body that gets more attention than her mind. She's sick of being underestimated—especially by arrogant Lion agent Asher Donnelly. But when they're forced to work together on a deadly case, sparks fly—and so do claws.

RIVER DRAGON
Sybil Harbor is used to feeling like the odd sister out. Then she meets a mysterious stranger who awakens something ancient and dangerous inside her. But Percy Calloway has a secret, and his betrayal could destroy her—unless love transforms them both.

Emotional, gripping, and full of fated mate heat, The Witch Shifter Clan trilogy delivers steamy urban fantasy romance with fierce heroines, broody Shifters, and heart-pounding adventure.

Magic. Mates. Mayhem. Get ready to fall for the Harbor sisters—one wild, wicked love story at a time.
